(b) Resolve the internal inconsistency where the 06:10 exchange is flagged as diarization-ambiguous in cherry_pick_moments[5] but then used as clean rep dialogue in objections[1].attempt_quotes — pick one treatment and apply consistently. No.') and may actually contain a real-time inclusion attempt by the rep that was declined, which would flip this from a missed protocol to a followed-but-declined protocol; soften the coaching_implication pending clearer transcript reading. (d) Consider adding the 00:31 bill-swap pitch contradiction ('completely eliminate' vs 'more affordable and cheaper') as its own cherry_pick_moments entry, since it's the customer's first pushback and directly shapes the guarded opening state currently attributed only to the customer's own framing.
